title: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE: Short-Horizon Queue Imbalance Study
public_summary: Synthetic conditioning fixture demonstrating OVCA intake for microstructure research
constraints: synthetic conformance fixture only — no live market data or alpha claim
assumptions: synthetic maker/taker fees remain fixed across the sample window
acceptance_criteria: alpha-ovca verify-stream exits 0 and matches brief_id, authority, and budget

hypothesis.statement: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: Extreme L1 queue imbalance precedes short-horizon mid-price tick shifts
hypothesis.economic_rationale: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: Asymmetric order arrival consumes top-of-book liquidity faster than replenishment
alternative_explanations: Quote flickering without true directional order flow
falsification_criteria: Net expected return after half-spread and fees is <= 0 on unseen out-of-sample slice

cost_model_assumptions: half-spread + 1.0 bps fee per round turn
quant_checks.multiple_testing_plan: Log total parameter evaluations and apply Bonferroni/DSR penalty

authority.objective: Validate synthetic OVCA workflow wiring under Conditioner gates
